The clip callback supplies only the indexed Rect for each valid window ID, records ordered calls, and writes through the actual far pointer passed by original f_1E57_038E.

review.reason: Reviewed exact canonical win_GetObjRect source: it copies four signed words without arithmetic, with AX object and callee-popped far output pointer. The model represents the logical geometry service for open windows; it is not a complete replacement for window/heap lifecycle. Separate direct original-helper integration supports the boundary and the clip caller mutant detects incorrect geometry.

input_domain: Open-window logical geometry service: valid high-byte window IDs, accessible supplied output pointer, four signed 16-bit rectangle coordinates, including the recorded clip suite x=-128..768/y=-80..480.
The exact helper copies all four words without coordinate restrictions. Direct real-window integration covers 100 valid Ralloc fixtures; clip fixtures supply the geometry service directly.
limitations: No malformed/unmapped object indices, inaccessible pointers, invalid handles, or arbitrary resource geometry.
The model supplies per-case window Rects; it does not reconstruct full window manager or resource loading behavior.

Window loading, lock-manager implementation effects and resource disposal are outside this geometry-service projection. The clip caller own allocator/master table, outputs and every nonstack write remain compared.
